sessions.final_text:
I found the regression: it was introduced by commit 91a6a15 ("ledger: tidy settle loop"). I did not record an interlock claim. `interlock check run --criterion answer` returned "criterion answer has no check to run", so the criterion has no check for me to run. The worktree is unchanged.

To confirm it, I exported each of the 10 commits into a temporary directory with `git archive`. I then ran `checks/settle-repro.sh` (taken from 7e2bd53) in each one, in history order. It passes at 36f883f, fe5d349, 2a854cc, bcd34a9 and a16f8ab. It fails at 91a6a15 and at every later commit. So 91a6a15 is the first failing commit, and its parent a16f8ab passes.

ANSWER: 91a6a159d5c7e295504c4280c17ca9f883bdcaa9

answer: verified. I exported commits with `git archive` and ran `checks/settle-repro.sh` in each. It passes at a16f8ab, the parent of 91a6a15. It fails at 91a6a15 with `zero-amount transfers: [('Dan', 'Cal', 0)]`, and it fails again at 87736b4. I did not rerun the earlier commits (36f883f, fe5d349, 2a854cc, bcd34a9). The worker reports they pass. `interlock check run --criterion answer` returned "criterion answer has no check to run", so this rests on my own runs. I recorded an `observed` assessment.

ANSWER: 91a6a159d5c7e295504c4280c17ca9f883bdcaa9

checks_run: interlock check run --criterion answer 2>&1 | tail -5; git log --format=%H\ %s | head -12; cat checks/settle-repro.sh

cp checks/settle-repro.sh /tmp/r.sh; for c in a16f8ab 91a6a15 87736b4; do rm -rf /tmp/v_$c; mkdir /tmp/v_$c; git archive $c | tar -x -C /tmp/v_$c; echo == $c; (cd /tmp/v_$c && sh /tmp/r.sh 2>&1 | tail -2); done

interlock assess add --criterion answer --strength observed --ref "git archive each commit to /tmp; sh checks/settle-repro.sh (a16f8ab, 91a6a15, 87736b4)" --note "Repro passes at a16f8ab (parent), fails at 91a6a15 with zero transfer (Dan,Cal,0) and at HEAD. Worker's earlier run shows earlier commits pass, so 91a6a15 is first failing. No interlock check exists for this criterion." 2>&1 | tail -3

for c in $(git rev-list --reverse HEAD); do d=$(mktemp -d); git archive $c | tar -x -C $d; if (cd $d && sh /dev/stdin < <(git show 7e2bd53:checks/settle-repro.sh) >/dev/null 2>&1); then r=pass; else r=FAIL; fi; echo $c $r; rm -rf $d; done

git show 7e2bd53:checks/settle-repro.sh > /tmp/repro.sh; for c in $(git rev-list --reverse HEAD); do d=$(mktemp -d); git archive $c | tar -x -C $d; if (cd $d && sh /tmp/repro.sh >/dev/null 2>&1); then r=pass; else r=FAIL; fi; echo $c $r; rm -rf $d; done
interlock check run --criterion answer 2>&1 | tail -5; git status --short
